GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when users need to update patient clinical notes after write capability has been evaluated. It applies to requests for appending information to existing clinical records.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user requests to update clinical notes, use the Enigma_Update_Clinical_Notes action.
Before appending text, ensure that write capability has been evaluated.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only append text to patient clinical notes after confirming that write capability has been evaluated. You cannot summarize or evaluate governance requirements within this topic.
